description.zh: 实用 Skills 与独立思考的开源百宝袋：收纳人生灵感、实践感悟、工具经验和具体场景的方法，欢迎共同完善，也为独立 GitHub 项目提供统一入口。
description.en: An open toolbox for practical skills and independent thinking, shaped by life experience, reflection, and tool use. Contributions are welcome, with a shared entry point for independent GitHub projects.

description.zh: 面向成年人自评，用基础资料、36项问答与照片可见观察建立私人角色档案；逐项保存、断点续测和局部复测，评分规则仍待确定。
description.en: Build a private self-review record for adults from basic information, 36 items, and visible photo observations. Save each answer, resume later, and revisit selected items; scoring rules remain undefined.

use_when: 成年人希望整理本人现状，并在之后继续补充或复核部分资料。 Adults want to record their own current situation and return to missing or outdated information.
需要把基础资料、问答和照片可见观察逐项存入本地私人档案。 Save basic information, answers, and visible photo observations to a local private record.
not_for: 已校准的心理、医学或能力测评，以及外形分、总分或全球百分位。 Validated psychological, medical, or ability assessment, appearance scores, total scores, or global percentiles.
未成年人外形评价、未经本人同意的他人评价，或从照片推断性格、智力、健康与财富。 Appearance assessment of minors, assessment of others without consent, or inferring personality, intelligence, health, or wealth from photos.
自动公开、提交或上传私人资料。 Automatically publishing, committing, or uploading private records.
inputs: 成年人本人同意，以及自行选择提供的基础资料与36项回答。 An adult's consent for self-review, basic information, and chosen answers across 36 items.
本人授权用于日常综合形象观察的照片；可以先完成不依赖照片的项目。 Authorized photos for visible everyday presentation observations; other items can proceed before photos are provided.
公开仓库与安装目录之外的私人存档目录。 A private state directory outside public repositories and the skill installation.
outputs: 本地私人 current.md，含输入进度、来源、日期和所有为空的分数。 A local private current.md with input progress, sources, dates, and null scores.
可恢复的采集进度、局部复测记录、历史快照与修订保护。 Resumable collection progress, selected-item retests, history snapshots, and revision protection.
requirements: Python 3.10+；运行器只使用标准库。 Python 3.10+; the runner uses the standard library only.
AI需有本地文件与命令执行权限；照片观察还需实际读取图片的能力。 The assistant needs local file and command access, plus image viewing for photo observations.

evidence.origin: 屁老师提出的六维角色档案设计，由 AI 协助整理为采集与存档流程。 A six-dimension personal record design proposed by Pi Laoshi, with AI-assisted collection and archival instructions.
evidence.validation: The authored fictional example was executed through the real store. 24 checkpoint tests and 27 catalog tests passed on Windows/Python 3.11; catalog, local links and metadata checked. This verifies persistence/resume/retest behavior, not human outcomes or assessment validity. All scores remain null; no calibrated scoring, total score or global percentile.

description.zh: 探索如何区分自己的愿望、现实约束和别人的人生时间表。
description.en: An idea for reviewing personal priorities, progress, outside expectations, and practical constraints.

use_when: The user wants to explore the proposed framework or contribute examples.
not_for: A universal life score or validated psychological assessment
inputs: A proposed life-stage question or anonymized case
outputs: An incubation brief to discuss and develop

evidence.origin: Proposed by the maintainer during the project's initial discussion.
evidence.validation: Idea only; the dimensions and worked cases have not been settled or behaviorally tested.

name.zh: 是判断变了，还是今天心情换了？
name.en: Did the evidence change, or just your mood?

description.zh: 受《Noise》启发，探索如何检查可比判断中的不必要差异。
description.en: A book-inspired idea for distinguishing evidence changes, changing criteria, and possible noise in comparable judgments.

use_when: The user wants to explore the proposed book-inspired workflow or contribute reading notes.
not_for: Reproducing the book or claiming author endorsement
inputs: Reading notes or comparable judgment examples
outputs: An incubation brief with sources and open design questions

evidence.origin: The maintainer's proposal, inspired by Noise by Kahneman, Sibony, and Sunstein.
evidence.validation: Idea only; the workflow awaits the maintainer's reading notes and comparable worked cases.
